article_title: 'Skimpflation' warning as tinned mackerel alternative hits more supermarket shelves

tasks.prompt: What is the article's main issue?
options: A ban on all canned fish in Britain
Concerns that cheaper jack mackerel is replacing traditional mackerel without equivalent price or nutrition
A new method of farming Atlantic mackerel
A shortage of metal used to manufacture tins
tasks.correct_answer: Concerns that cheaper jack mackerel is replacing traditional mackerel without equivalent price or nutrition
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה בוחנת את החלפת המקרל המסורתי ב־jack mackerel הזול והפחות מזין, ואת הטענה שמדובר ב־skimpflation.

tasks.prompt: How does jack mackerel compare nutritionally with traditional mackerel?
options: It has twice as much omega-3
It has about half the omega-3 and one-third the vitamin B12
It contains no protein or vitamins
Its nutritional values are identical
tasks.correct_answer: It has about half the omega-3 and one-third the vitamin B12
tasks.explanation_hebrew: לפי הכתבה, ב־jack mackerel יש בערך מחצית מכמות אומגה־3 וכשליש מכמות ויטמין B12 שבמקרל מסורתי.

tasks.prompt: What does “skimpflation” mean as used by Which?
options: Raising prices because tins become larger
Replacing every product with a sustainable one
Quietly reducing a product's quality or ingredients while shoppers may pay the same
Selling fish only during inflation
tasks.correct_answer: Quietly reducing a product's quality or ingredients while shoppers may pay the same
tasks.explanation_hebrew: skimpflation היא הפחתה שקטה באיכות או במרכיבים, לעיתים בלי הפחתה מקבילה במחיר.

tasks.prompt: Why has jack mackerel been introduced by suppliers and retailers?
options: Atlantic mackerel stocks have fallen after years of overfishing
Consumers asked for fish with less omega-3
UK law banned traditional mackerel in 2025
Jack mackerel is caught only in British waters
tasks.correct_answer: Atlantic mackerel stocks have fallen after years of overfishing
tasks.explanation_hebrew: המעבר נבע מהידלדלות מלאי המקרל האטלנטי בעקבות שנים של דיג יתר; החלופה הצ'יליאנית נחשבת בת־קיימא יותר.

tasks.prompt: Why might shoppers still confuse jack mackerel with traditional mackerel?
options: Both fish belong to the same scientific family
Jack mackerel is sold only without labels
The similar name and packaging may hide that it is a different species
Traditional mackerel has no legal marketing name
tasks.correct_answer: The similar name and packaging may hide that it is a different species
tasks.explanation_hebrew: למרות הסימון, השם הדומה והאריזה הדומה עלולים לגרום לקונים לא להבין שמדובר במין אחר ובמוצר בעל ערכים שונים.

tasks.prompt: What does “stocks have plummeted” mean in the article?
options: Fish prices have risen slowly
The fish population has fallen very sharply
Catches have moved to deeper water
Retailers have increased their supplies
tasks.correct_answer: The fish population has fallen very sharply
tasks.explanation_hebrew: plummeted פירושו ירד בצורה חדה מאוד; מלאי המקרל ירד בכשלושה רבעים בתוך עשור.

tasks.prompt: Describe the evidence that north-east Atlantic mackerel is under severe pressure.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין נתונים על חריגה ממכסות מומלצות, הירידה במלאי, המלצת הקיצוץ והשלכות ההסמכה.
expected_points: Catches exceeded scientific advice by an average of 39% over 15 years
Stocks fell by roughly three-quarters over the past decade
Ices advised cutting the 2026 catch by about 70%
The Marine Conservation Society called the population at breaking point
Atlantic mackerel lost MSC certification
Some retailers' sustainability policies no longer allow the fish

tasks.prompt: Explain the trade-off between sustainability and consumer value in the switch to jack mackerel.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להציג הן את יתרונות הקיימות של החלופה והן את החסרונות במחיר, תזונה, טעם, סימון וטביעת פחמן.
expected_points: Chilean jack mackerel is MSC-certified
It reduces pressure on depleted Atlantic mackerel
It costs roughly one-third as much at wholesale
Retail prices may remain similar
It contains less omega-3 and vitamin B12
Consumers report different taste and texture
Some buyers may not notice the species change
Importing it from farther away may increase the carbon footprint

tasks.prompt: Summarise why the product switch happened, why it is controversial and how retailers have responded.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לסכם באנגלית את משבר הדיג, החלפת המין, טענת ה־skimpflation, בעיית הסימון ותגובות החברות והחנויות.
expected_points: Atlantic mackerel stocks have been depleted by overfishing
Princes and Lidl sell jack mackerel alternatives
Jack mackerel is a different fish family
It is cheaper and less nutritious
Which calls the change skimpflation when quality falls without a lower price
Suppliers say products are clearly labelled and sustainability-certified
Industry representatives warn of consumer confusion and carbon impacts
Waitrose suspended or phased out mackerel products over sustainability concerns

tasks.prompt: Write a clear supermarket shelf notice explaining the switch from mackerel to jack mackerel.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכתוב באנגלית הודעה שקופה ולא מטעה הכוללת את זהות המין, סיבת ההחלפה, הבדלי התזונה והטעם ומידע על קיימות.
expected_points: State that jack mackerel is a different species
Avoid presenting it as identical to traditional mackerel
Explain that Atlantic stocks have declined
Mention the sustainability certification of the alternative
Disclose the lower omega-3 and vitamin B12 levels
Mention the milder flavour or meatier texture
Use prominent and straightforward wording
